title: RAW one SUPPLIES constructor over actual otar/otaiin in the complete outside line
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Reuse ar=HEAT and aiin=MOISTURE under one finite ot constructor: an element supplies a quality. The two actual compounds in complete f85r2.1 must acquire different written element subjects, distinguishing production from containment or predominance.

design.source_relation: The complete print separately attributes warmth to fire and moisture to water; it also gives blood to water, flesh/bone to earth, and breath to air. Those latter obligations remain part of a future whole-source reading, not silently omitted. These are historical claims, not modern physiology.

ot.law: ot(q)(e) = SUPPLIES(e,q), a causal contribution by element e, not e's identity with q or a patient's possession/predominance of q.

actual_two_inputs: All three readers have exact otar at f85r2.1 G008 and exact otaiin at G013.
The bare ar at .1 G004 and aiin at ZL/IT .1 G030 retain those same Quality denotations; RF .1 @221;iin remains unbound. All four-block bare occurrences retain the same values.
design.prospective_subject_binding: A source-faithful completion should bind the HEAT contribution to a written FIRE element and MOISTURE contribution to a written WATER element. No target form is yet assigned either element; source order, proximity and pictures do not license an implicit participant list. Each subject must be explicit or recovered through a declared, counted written construction.
no_hidden_extensions: Exactly two ot compounds are licensed. otodar, otodaiin, otedy and other ot-looking forms stay separate unassigned wholes; this is not a universal productive prefix assertion.

The nearby ZL otodar/otodaiin might tempt nesting, but ot expects a Quality, not the predicate produced by d in card24. No implicit type coercion or o deletion is allowed. IT otadar and RF ot@221;dar remain distinct.
No water-to-blood or earth/air relation is claimed to have been deciphered. Missing clauses cannot be dropped because two pairs fit.
design.distinct_consequence: With explicit element subjects, fire supplying heat and water supplying moisture support two different causal contributions while every person can still contain all elements. A literal swap of those subjects changes both propositions; a possession-only model does not assert either contribution.

rivals.name: CONTAINS quality
rivals.contract: ot(q)(e)=CONTAINS(e,q). It shares types but makes a membership claim and does not predict a supplied effect.

rivals.name: PREDOMINANT component
rivals.contract: ot(q)(x)=PREDOMINATES(q,x), with owner type Person instead of Element. It requires a different written argument type and cannot silently share element subjects.

design.falsifier: In a completed whole .1/.24 plus four-block reading, both ot compounds must use the same causal operation with explicitly bound Element arguments and the source's distinct contributions. Reject this exact mapping if either word requires a person predicate or another relation, or if the required element subjects cannot be expressed without an implicit list. Non-identification of subjects now is an honest missing binding, not a semantic failure.

freedom.economy: Two more complete forms can be derived after two common atom meanings are fixed; subject and source-effect vocabulary remain substantial costs. No independent evidence establishes the segmentation.

design.strongest_countercase: Element subjects and all other effects remain unbound in the complete line; the nearby longer ot forms cannot currently be composed under this simple type contract. No supplied-quality consequence has been semantically executed.
